{!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in the College of Nursing & Health Innovation at Arizona State University.
We are excited to offer a Bachelor of Applied Science (BAS) with a concentration in Health Innovation. This degree is designed for students who want to lead transformative change in health through the creation of new products, processes and systems. Students will integrate their current health care background with innovation and leadership education, reflecting on who they are as an innovator and a leader. Students will have the opportunity to examine current evidence-based practice and health care policy through a lens of innovation using an integrated systems perspective, and they will begin to hone the skills necessary to be a leader of innovation in a health care context.
Offered at both ASU’s Downtown Phoenix and West campuses, the BAS in Health Innovation was developed for transfer students with an AAS degree in an allied health field or an AAS in business or a related field with employment experience in the health industry. The AAS transfers as a block of 60 credit hours to the BAS, offering a seamless transition and ensuring students don’t lose credits when transferring to ASU. In some cases, students may transfer up to 75 credit hours from their community college.
You can view more information including employment opportunities and a major map online.
If you are ready to join the Sun Devil community, apply now for admission.
If you have additional questions or concerns, please respond to this email or call our office at 602-496-0937 and we will be happy to assist you.
Sincerely,
Recruitment and Admissions College of Nursing and Health Innovation Phone: 602-496-0937 Office Hours: Monday - Friday, 8 a.m. - 5 p.m. asu.hci@asu.edu nursingandhealth.asu.edu
